passive.name: Clockwork Windup
passive.description: Orianna's Attacks deal additional magic damage. This damage increases the more Orianna Attacks the same target.

spells.name: Command: Attack
spells.description: Orianna commands her Ball to move to an area, dealing magic damage to surrounding enemies and to enemies it passes through. Deals % less damage to all enemies after the first.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamageTooltip was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Command: Dissonance
spells.description: Orianna commands her Ball to release an electric pulse, dealing magic damage to surrounding enemies. The pulse leaves behind an energy field for seconds, Slowing enemies by % and granting allies % Move Speed, decaying over seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Command: Protect
spells.description: Passive: The Ball adds Armor and Magic Resist to the allied champion it is attached to. Active: Orianna commands her Ball to attach to an allied champion, granting them Shield for seconds. Enemies the Ball passes through take magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamageTooltip was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Command: Shockwave
spells.description: Orianna commands her Ball to unleash a shockwave, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and Knocking them in the direction of the Ball.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
